issues.description: Numeric threshold mismatch for Aufgabe 04: the problem statement (problem_statement.md line 31) requires counting swimming pools in Gemeinden with more than 1000 female inhabitants ("mehr als 1000 weiblichen Einwohnerinnen"), but the provided solution (solution_repository/aufgabe04.sql line 4) uses a threshold of 2000 (WHERE Gemeinde.einwohner_w > 2000). This inconsistency will make expected query results and automated tests disagree and will confuse students about the correct condition to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the threshold consistent. Preferred fix: update solution_repository/aufgabe04.sql line 4 to use WHERE Gemeinde.einwohner_w > 1000 to match the problem statement. Alternatively, if the intended threshold is 2000, update problem_statement.md and any tests to specify "mehr als 2000" and document the change.
